steps.text: Part 2 of 2: The safety scan: look before you move. This part covers Check yourself. Each part is short on purpose: finish one, play a game or take a break, and come back.

In mixed practice the two scan questions are hidden. You can open them and the app notes that you did. The plan: the app stops showing them once you solve five mixed items in a row with them closed (five is a first guess). The next item is silent: no prompts, no hints, no engine.

steps.prompt: Before you read the model answer, explain it in your own words, as if to a friend.

fields.label: In two sentences: why can a defended knight still be unsafe, and what do you ask before capturing a loose piece?

steps.text: **A model answer, to compare with yours.** Before I move, I ask what the last move attacked or opened, and whether any of my pieces is loose. Then I ask the same about my own move: what does it stop guarding? A defended piece attacked by a cheaper piece can still lose value, and a loose enemy piece is a chance only after I have checked the capture.

steps.prompt: The last item was silent. Before you moved, did you run the two scan questions without being told to? Answer honestly: this record is for you, not a grade.

fields.label: Did you run the scan before moving?
What did the scan show? (one line)
In your next real game, on which moves will you run the scan on purpose?
